_comment: P3G.2 (#22) PR-blocking gate baseline. pass_rate is (passed / (passed + failed)) among NON-xfail cases for the category, from a clean `pytest evals/ -m "not integration"` run -- see evals/conftest.py's pytest_sessionfinish hook and evals/runner/gate.py. Regenerate by running the suite and updating a category's pass_rate deliberately (in its own commit, with a reason) whenever an intentional, reviewed change lowers it -- never to silence an unexplained regression.

citation_present._note: #115 (does not change pass_rate or the 3/12 total -- both cases remain honestly xfail): root-caused the SourceRef misattribution #109 flagged for dual-antiplatelet-question/hypertension-lifestyle-followup-question. Live re-verification (production LlamaServerClient, run_case, temperature=0 -- every draw byte-identical, 6+ draws for dual-antiplatelet, 3+ for hypertension) found genuine FABRICATION, not a #85-style recoverable misrouted-ref shape: both questions state the relevant chart fact directly in the question text (medications / blood pressure + lifestyle plan), so the planner never dispatches get_medications/get_vitals at all -- the extractor then invents a syntactically well-formed but entirely fabricated SourceRef (a real call_id paired with a field name that appears in NO real tool-result catalog entry) to back the claim anyway, alongside a genuinely VALID, verbatim guideline_chunk DocumentCitation on some claims (both cases DO cite their guideline chunk correctly -- that half of #109's finding holds). Per this issue's own conservative instruction, no coercion fix was implemented: there is no reconstructable structure to safely recover from (unlike #85's <doc_id>#<section> shape), and even a narrow fix for the one recoverable-looking duplicate-ref pattern would not flip either case to verified (other, unrelated claims in the same answer are separately and independently fabricated with no valid citation to fall back on). check_claim's existing fail-closed AND-aggregation already handles this correctly; a hermetic regression test (test_verification_documents.py) now locks in this exact shape. The upstream, out-of-scope root cause (the planner never dispatching a confirming tool call for a chart fact the question already states, so no real citable record exists at all) is filed as issue #123 for the maintainer. See docs/MODEL_AND_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md, 'Issue #115 findings', for the full trace. #116 (this fix supersedes the #108 note below): re-verified warfarin-antibiotic-question and metformin-renal-monitoring-question live (production LlamaServerClient, evals.runner.pipeline.run_case, no replay, 10 fresh draws each) -- the ORIGINAL chart-data-only xfail rationale for both is stale (does not reproduce), but only warfarin-antibiotic-question actually moves off xfail: it verified 10/10 with two real, verbatim guideline_chunk DocumentCitations passing both provenance AND semantic support every time. metformin-renal-monitoring-question's verdict also reaches verified 10/10, but for the WRONG reason -- the claim extractor never attaches a real DocumentCitation for the guideline quote; instead it duplicates an unrelated, trivially-valid chart-data SourceRef several times per guideline-derived claim, which satisfies check_claim's citation-validity AND-aggregation without ever citing the guideline. guideline_citation_present correctly fails 10/10, so the case remains honestly xfail with a rationale describing this newly-observed extraction-misattribution mechanism (also correcting issue #109's own spike finding for this case). A larger (10-draw) live sample was also taken of statin-liver-monitoring-question's chart-data-only behavior specifically (flagged inconclusive by #109 at n=3): 0/13 combined draws reproduced a chart-data-only outcome, ruling that pattern out as a small-sample artifact -- but the case still did not reach verified in any of the 10 new draws (a different, unrelated mechanism), so it remains honestly xfail too. pass_rate is 1.0 because CategoryStats.pass_rate is computed over non-xfail cases only (3 passed / 0 failed here) -- honest gate-ON total is now 3/12, up from the previous 2/12 (see docs/MODEL_AND_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md, 'Issue #116 follow-up'). #108's prior note, for history: app.semantic_support's duplicate-claim judge inconsistency (two claims restating one guideline-backed fact, both citing the IDENTICAL DocumentCitation, judged with two independent -- and sometimes disagreeing -- LLM calls) was fixed by grouping DocumentCitation results by exact evidence identity and judging each identity once. Live re-verification: a1c-target-question 7/8 draws verified, lithium-nsaid-question 8/8 draws verified; both cases' xfail markers were removed and fresh verified recordings committed, moving the total from 0/12 to 2/12 at that time. #100's prior note, for history: the committed 5/12 baseline's 5 non-xfail cases (bp-stage2-question, a1c-target-question, dual-antiplatelet-question, hypertension-lifestyle-followup-question, lithium-nsaid-question) each reflected one STABLE, frozen recording from an earlier draw that was never re-checked against a fresh live draw; re-running all 5 live found every one of them failed to reliably reproduce verified at that time (1/42 live draws). bp-stage2-question, dual-antiplatelet-question, and hypertension-lifestyle-followup-question remain xfail today for reasons unrelated to #108/#116 (see docs/MODEL_AND_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md).
